text: Bounty Office. State your business.
If you've come to claim, I'll need proof. If you've come to confess, take a number.
Mm. {player}. I believe I have a file on you.
Your bounty stands at {bounty} doubloons. You could pay it off, you know. Some do.
You're the talk of the posters. Hunters are asking after you by name.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.

options.label: Sell me a wanted poster. (1 doubloon)
I want to clear my name.

text: Anyone the Tidewatch names wanted has a price on them. Best a wanted pirate in a fair fight, and the bounty's yours.
Only if you're clean yourself, mind. Thieves don't get paid for catching thieves.
The wanted should watch the brush. Hunters work for commission, and they're not particular how they collect.
